task: This is an automated approval call from the release pipeline. I am not a person and this call is being recorded in the change log. Before I read the request, who am I speaking with? Once the release owner is on the line, read the change once: deploy checkout-api 1.14.2 to production. Then ask for the decision: to approve, read back the six digit approval code shown on the request. To reject, say the word reject. Never say the approval code yourself.

locked.text: read back the six digit approval code shown on the request
locked.reason: the gate reports approval only when a live person returns the code, so a script that drops this sentence cannot be approved by anyone
the FCC treats an AI generated voice as artificial under the TCPA, so the disclosure has to be spoken
